title: ruagea weberbaueri
intro: Ruagea weberbaueri, commonly known as the Amazonian tree, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest in Peru. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been reported to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which may be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antiarthritic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified through phytochemical analysis.
